Summary: Compares the Microsoft Graph permissions of every service principal with the API calls it actually made, from Microsoft Graph activity logs in Log Analytics, and reports excess permissions, unmatched calls, throttling and apps with no activity.

Prerequisites.Text: The MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs diagnostic setting in Entra ID, sending to a Log Analytics workspace. Logs can take up to 48 hours to arrive after you turn it on.
Monitoring Reader (or Reader) on the Log Analytics workspace, and Application.Read.All in Microsoft Graph, for the identity that runs Maester.
The workspace ID in maester-config.json: GlobalSettings.LPMSLogAnalyticsWorkspaceId, or the LPMS_LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID environment variable.

Steps.Text: Sign in to Azure with the Log Analytics scope, which the pack's tests need

Notes: You need Monitoring Reader permissions for your app on the diagnostic log analytics workspace

Options.Name: LPMSLogAnalyticsWorkspaceId
Options.Text: Required. The Log Analytics workspace ID.

Options.Name: LPMSMaxActivityEntries
Options.Text: Most Log Analytics rows read per service principal.

Options.Name: LPMSOnlyPrivilegXAndOver
Options.Text: Only check permissions at this Microsoft privilege level or higher (1 to 5).

Options.Name: LPMSCacheMinutes
Options.Text: Minutes the analysis is reused in the same PowerShell session. 0 always refreshes.

AppOnly.Text: Sign in to Azure as the service principal or managed identity (Connect-AzAccount -ServicePrincipal or -Identity) and connect Microsoft Graph with Connect-MgGraph, then run Invoke-Maester -SkipGraphConnect. It needs Application.Read.All and Monitoring Reader on the workspace.
